slides.title: A first word
slides.transcript: [warmly] Bismillah. A first word, for Noah. <break time="0.5s" /> [gently] The word we say before everything. Say it with me.

slides.title: Susu's Bowl
slides.transcript: [warmly] Loza's Bowl. <break time="0.4s" /> You fill the bowl, and the cat comes running. A small kindness is still a kindness. <break time="0.5s" /> [softly] Bismillah.

slides.title: Goodnight
slides.transcript: [softly] Goodnight. <break time="0.4s" /> Every day begins with one word, and every day ends with it too. <break time="0.5s" /> [whispers] Bismillah. Goodnight, Noah.
